scientific_question: Whether trained compositional realization retains requested facts and human-like expression in three categories absent from fitting and SELECT, at competitive total resource cost relative to strong conventional controls.
source_role: official DEV in category SHA256 first byte modulo 4 = 0

prespecified_scoring.primary: Requested-content per-triple TRAIN-derived lexical proxy, with explicit n/d denominators; not semantic entailment.
prespecified_scoring.entity: Normalized source subject/object surface presence and missing slots; extra-entity/contradiction proxies reported separately with explicit limitations.
prespecified_scoring.language: Reference chrF approximate F2 ngram 1..6 and token F1, per-reference aggregation including multi-reference support; report abbreviated references if parser falls short, no cherry picking.
prespecified_scoring.macro: Per-category counts, denominators, scores, macro average across each of three held-out categories; keep micro auxiliary only.
prespecified_scoring.abstention: Count and score as zero requested coverage and zero fluency. Not omitted from denominator.
prespecified_scoring.resources: Whole-fit and preprocessing wall/CPU (including state reconstruction), model load, complete serial audit wall/CPU, RSS/peak Python-traced, serialized bytes; energy/FLOPs NOT_MEASURED unless actual instrumentation.
prespecified_scoring.compare: Same source roles and outputs for all arms. Record special V2 inference costs rather than laundering as V1.

before_first_audit_reference_read: Frozen contract and source-hash identity committed
Separate implementation and synthetic/adversarial tests frozen
Linux and Windows public qualification PASS for exact implementation
Seal exact bytes verified; every selected checkpoint and state hash pinned
One-run first-use output paths and logs explicitly prohibited from persisting corpus text
on_first_use: Verify 176 TRAIN/DEV Git blob OIDs before content read
Verify exact train/select/audit deterministic counts and category/graph partition
Inference sees triples only, never original references
Only scoring process receives reference text after prediction is produced
No stdout or artifact raw predictions, references, triples, or entity names
All methods use frozen source and weights and no new training
No official TEST, no paid API, no protected merge
after_first_use: Write numerical per-arm/per-category and macro-averaged custody evidence only
Keep scientific_go false absent independent semantic checking, strong comparator/resources and zero hard false positives
No tuning after audit; negative finding retained

negative_controls: Reject absent/mutated selection seal and source model hashes
Reject TRAIN/SELECT examples in audit role or overlapping graph hashes
Reject any per-category omitted records or micro-only aggregate
Reject missed control/seeds and checkpoint identity drift
Reject attempted second first-use audit or artifact overwrite
Reject raw target/source strings in final numerical receipts
note: This contract permits one first-use held-out assessment only after exact program qualification. A proxy win cannot be promoted to scientific success without independently adjudicated semantic fidelity and full resource accounting.
